mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 3.5% does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increases do not correlate with subsequent economic expansion indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals increased economic activity and supply-side strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with subsequent economic activity indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals accommodative monetary policy and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy and strong labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint decrease in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent positive market performance.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decreases do not correlate with subsequent weakening consumer demand indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 3-month moving average signals job market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increases do not correlate with subsequent job market strength indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a regime of economic contraction.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases do not correlate with subsequent supply-side weakness indicators in contractionary regimes.
